name: Continue
shortDescription: Open-source coding agent and IDE extension. The /pricing URL returned 404 on our check.
longDescription: Continue is an open-source coding agent that runs as an IDE extension. We checked the homepage, docs, and GitHub releases. continue.dev/pricing returned HTTP 404, so there is no separate pricing page in this listing — the open-source extension is the free path we could confirm. We did not install the extension.
pricingNotes: Confirm any Continue cloud/team pricing on site; OSS install is IDE extension (not pip-tested here).
bestFor: Developers who want an open-source copilot in the IDE
Teams that would rather extend the editor they already use
notIdealFor: A hosted IDE with a published price grid
A confirmed cloud plan — the pricing URL 404’d
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).
